content.text:
**Resubmitted at the preferred level with the two operative repairs.**

- **§ 21.1:** cap basis replaced with "the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000" — this cures the illusory USD 12,000 / first-Order-Form measure and puts an express 12-month fee basis *and* a fixed floor in operative language.
- **§ 21.3:** payment carve-out broadened from "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" to "amounts due under this Agreement and any Order Form," so Customer's payment obligations as a whole sit outside capped damages rather than only the narrow defined "Fees".
- **Already met and left verbatim:** mutuality of the cap (§ 21.1), the mutual indirect/consequential exclusion (§ 21.2, now cited and rendered), and the full Excluded Claims list — confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP (§ 21.3).
- Minimality passed on both operations; no survival tails, procedures or extra carve-outs added, and no cross-reference or defined term left dangling.
